stepTitle: A $$3000\, \text{kg}$$ cannon is mounted so that it can recoil only in the horizontal direction. Calculate its recoil velocity when it fires a $$15.0\, \text{kg}$$ shell at $$480\,\text{m/s}$$ at an angle of $$20.0**\circ$$ above the horizontal. Give the velocity to three significant figures (in $$\text{m/s})$$.
